context.title: Silicon Valley Taxpayers Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Bay Area — Regional Measure RTM (Regional Transit Measure)

positions.statement: Mark W.A. Hinkle (President: Silicon Valley Taxpayers Association) signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of Bay Area Regional Measure RTM and the argument against Bay Area Regional Measure RTM in the Santa Clara County Voter Information Guide.
Mark W.A. Hinkle (President: Silicon Valley Taxpayers Association) signed the argument against Gilroy Measure B in the Santa Clara County Voter Information Guide.
